parentReview: Root reviewed the entire source and approved after both fixtures passed.

tests.requestIsolation: The captured legacy membership helper sets transaction-local row_security. The savepoint fixture restores PostgREST's per-request default before each simulated request.
coverage: Direct and group RPC creation bind the exact live request session.
Absent, forged, foreign, anonymous, expired and revoked sessions fail closed.
Privileged manual calls retain insertion behavior but have no push provenance.
Per-send service check revalidates initiating session, current business member/device binding, current recipient membership/invitation, blocks, Auth/profile state, call state and expiry.
Claim is unique per call and recipient; claims do not replace fresh send authorization.
Session revocation cascades provenance and prevents subsequent sends.

trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER aa_call_push_origin AFTER INSERT ON public.call_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notification_delivery.record_call_origin()

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (call_id) REFERENCES call_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES auth.sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

limits: Local provider-contract fixtures do not establish real Auth token issuance or physical push receipt.
No service credential, JWT or token is recorded.
Original installed notification receipt is preserved; this follow-up intentionally replaces only claim implementation and adds provenance/current eligibility.
